24fa/2.3.solution:
let split_deque (d : 'a deque) (x : 'a) : 'a deque * 'a deque =
  let rec loop (dno : 'a dqnode option) : 'a deque * 'a deque =
    begin match dno with
    | None -> (d, create ())
    | Some n ->
      if n.v = x then
        begin match n.prev with
        | None -> (create (), d)
        | Some p ->
          let d2 = { head = dno; tail = d.tail } in
          d.tail <- n.prev;
          p.next <- None;
          n.prev <- None;
          (d, d2)
        end
      else loop n.next
    end
  in loop d.head

25sp/1.6.solution:
let remove_cycle (q : 'a queue) : unit =
  let rec loop (qno : 'a qnode option) (l : 'a qnode list) : unit =
    begin match qno with
    | None -> ()
    | Some qn ->
      begin match qn.next with
      | None -> ()
      | Some next_qn ->
        if contains_qn next_qn l then
          (qn.next <- None; q.tail <- Some qn)
        else loop qn.next (qn :: l)
      end
    end in
  loop q.head []

let transform_tr (f : 'a -> 'b) (l : 'a list) : 'b list =

mock1/2.4.solution:
let remove_all (x : 'a) (q : 'a queue) : unit =
  let rec loop (prev : 'a qnode option) (curr : 'a qnode option) : unit =
    begin match curr with
    | None -> q.tail <- prev
    | Some n ->
      if n.v = x then begin
        (begin match prev with
         | None -> q.head <- n.next
         | Some p -> p.next <- n.next
         end);
        loop prev n.next
      end else loop curr n.next
    end
  in loop None q.head

let take_while_tr (p : 'a -> bool) (l : 'a list) : 'a list =
  let rec rev (l : 'a list) (acc : 'a list) : 'a list =
    begin match l with
    | [] -> acc
    | x :: tl -> rev tl (x :: acc)
    end in
  let rec loop (l : 'a list) (acc : 'a list) : 'a list =
    begin match l with
    | [] -> rev acc []
    | x :: tl -> if p x then loop tl (x :: acc) else rev acc []
    end
  in loop l []

mock3/2.4.solution:
let insert_after (q : 'a queue) (x : 'a) (y : 'a) : unit =
  let rec loop (no : 'a qnode option) : unit =
    begin match no with
    | None -> ()
    | Some n ->
      if n.v = x then begin
        let fresh = { v = y; next = n.next } in
        n.next <- Some fresh;
        if fresh.next = None then q.tail <- Some fresh
      end else loop n.next
    end
  in loop q.head
